decision.message: The esp32_bmp280_v1 board family does not support a USB interface or USB data connection. It only supports an external regulated 3.2–3.4 V supply and does not include USB power or data functionality.

clauses.text: Power this pressure controller directly from a 5 V USB port and provide a USB data connection.
